215-1879-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-1879-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3752-7310-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-7310-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Kitsune.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

6132-6495-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
6132-6495-6981.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5541-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Bazaar Trader to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2073-2511-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1409-3099-3755-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

847-1459-1636-5361.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Auton Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Auton Soldier trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
847-1459-1636-5361.notes: Once you have extra mana, you can choose the other modes of Galadriel. You can also blink other creatures using Gilraen.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-5686-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1636-5089-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-5089-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

3259-3480-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

60-223-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
60-223-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Expansion targeting the original Expansion.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Expansion copy, creating a copy of Expansion, targeting the original Expansion.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Expansion copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

1409-6441-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2292-2842-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1495-6593-7061.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Solid Ground.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6593-7061.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

1003-4050-4763--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {R}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-1532-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-4050.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1115-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1115-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

1003-2173-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

1399-1606-5396-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
1399-1606-5396-6071.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

549-3259-5953-6791.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-3188-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2999-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2999-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1858-2146--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2146--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2691-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
2691-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ilysian Caryatid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

578-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Metalworker and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
578-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Metalworker's ability by tapping it, revealing an artifact card from your hand and adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

586-2146-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-3967-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-3967-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1049-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1049-1409-4050.description:
Activate Jirina by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating at least two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jirina.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If you've cast your commander at least four times from the command zone this game, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

4444-4798-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4444-4798-5631-5686.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, giving Noose Constrictor +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

2226-3399.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {10}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2226-3399.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {10}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W}.
When Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning it and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {11}{R}{G}{W}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.

1543-2247-2369.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other planeswalkers.
Teferi has an amount of loyalty counters on it equal to eleven minus twice the number of other planeswalkers you control.
1543-2247-2369.description:
Activate Teferi by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on itself.
Repeat step 1 twice for each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 and 2.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

774-2137-4036.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
774-2137-4036.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.

1247-1506-1912.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1506-1912.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1247-1912-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1734-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Fiend Hunter's power.
Repeat.
